findings.passage: This law cannot be repealed by the General Assembly because it was passed as a Constitutional Amendment.  I  would like to see it go back on the ballot to be repealed by the people or be struck down by the courts.
findings.note: Her written answer to the Indy Week candidate questionnaire (question 15, asking if she would support repealing the state voter ID law after the 2020 election). Page publish date used.
subjects: repeal of the state photo ID law

findings.motion: HB 1246, Safeguarding Elections Act (listed sponsor; not the primary sponsor)
findings.note: She is a listed sponsor of HB 1246, filed 2026-07-30 and sent to the Rules committee 2026-08-04. The bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H1246v0.pdf) adds to the list of election offences: "For any person to demand citizenship documentation from a voter other than what State law requires at any point during the voting process." It also bars certain observer conduct and protects voters' personal data.
NC House, Third Reading (roll call #810), 2024-12-11: nay (tally 73–45); census gate: none.
